title: JAK-STAT x MDD imaging-transcriptomics: a multi-modal evaluation with positive controls (analysis code and derived results)
description: Code, derived result tables and figures accompanying the manuscript 'The cortical principal gradient accounts for reported transcriptomic-imaging convergence of JAK-STAT signaling in major depressive disorder: a multi-modal evaluation with positive controls'. Convergent nulls across spatial (matched gene-set nulls, PC1-PC5 gradient control), genetic (competitive MAGMA, cis-MR at IL6R rs2228145) and postmortem (GSE53987, schizophrenia positive control) layers, with Bayes factors and minimum-reporting guidance for imaging-transcriptomic enrichment claims.
